name: Emergent
description:
Emergent lets you build production-ready web and mobile apps using plain language. Describe what you want to build, and Emergent's AI agents handle the rest: frontend, backend, database, authentication, payments, and deployment.

With the Emergent app in Claude, you can start a build directly from a conversation, check the status of apps you're already building, and iterate on features without leaving your chat. Your apps come with hosting, secure databases, and GitHub sync built in, so you own the code and can take it anywhere.

Whether you're a founder validating an idea, a product manager prototyping a feature, or a team building internal tools, Emergent takes you from idea to a live, working product in minutes instead of weeks.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Emergent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Emergent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.emergent.sh/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Emergent MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Emergent provides these MCP tools: create_job, get_job_preview, get_job_status, get_recent_trajectories, list_jobs, pause_job, send_message, and wait_for_job.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Emergent?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Emergent in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Emergent requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Emergent is developed by Emergent. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
